name: Stress — Malformed inputs don't crash tools
mechanical_verification: Call tools with empty/missing/null inputs, verify graceful error responses

verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Returns error string or empty string, not an exception

pass_criteria.lint_empty_graceful: lint with empty target returns error gracefully
pass_criteria.memory_empty_graceful: hermes_remember with empty topic returns error gracefully
pass_criteria.symbols_missing_graceful: symbols on missing file returns error gracefully

failure_modes.crashes_on_empty: Tools crash with unhandled exception on empty input
failure_modes.hangs_on_missing: Tools hang indefinitely on missing files
